world_news.headline: Australia news live: charges laid after alleged replica gun scare in Sydney entertainment spot
world_news.summary:
Two men were arrested on Monday evening and one was charged over an alleged replica pistol. Follow today’s news live.

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

‘Grim news’ on bird flu but country well prepared, environment minister says

Murray Watt, the federal environment minister, added that Australia is likely to see more mass mortality events, in line with what has happened overseas in other countries where bird flu has affected local wildlife populations.

I’m sorry to have such grim news at this hour of the morning but it’s best to be honest with people. As you know, Australia is the last continent on earth to have this strain of bird flu come to our shores. It was inevitable that it would come here at some point but the fact that it has taken a bit of time means that we are well prepared as a country.

But the reality is that we are going to see increased numbers of birds die as a result of this virus. And, of course, it can potentially get into mammals as well. So grim news ahead.

world_news.summary:
President says he will ‘let the families figure that out’ and calls situation ‘a very sad thing’ when asked if Ohio Republican should step down

  • Sign up for the US Breaking News email

On Tuesday, we’ll bring you the latest from Michigan where voters will head to the polls for competitive primaries in Senate and House races.

The most closely watched competition is the Democratic primary for the US Senate, where congresswoman Haley Stevens is up against former public health official Abdul El-Sayed. They’re vying to ultimately win the seat of outgoing senator Gary Peters in November. The race has now turned into a proxy battle for the future of the Democratic party. Establishment-backed Stevens has received support from party leaders and her race has been buoyed by millions from the pro-Israel lobby. Meanwhile the insurgent El-Sayed has built a strong grassroots movement and is endorsed by progressives lawmakers in the Democratic caucus.
